description: Two long-handled maces cross diagonally beneath round, open-centered heads. Short blunt spikes project around each head, and the matching weapons form a balanced X with their handles extending downward.
An upright Y-shaped slingshot has a deep curved fork and a straight handle. A broad band stretches diagonally back to the left, ending in a curved pouch beside the handle.
A sling has a narrow pouch at the upper left and two long cords that sweep down and cross into a large loop at the upper right. A separate round stone sits below the loop.
A sword rises diagonally from a round pommel at the lower left to a broad pointed blade at the upper right. A straight crossguard separates the narrow grip from the blade's angular shoulders.
Three upward-pointing chevrons are stacked vertically with matching wide arms. The upper two have sharp peaks, while the lowest has a slightly rounded apex; all three remain separate marks.
A sleeveless vest has broad shoulder straps, a deep neckline, and two horizontal bands across the lower torso. A round bomb with a short curved fuse is attached centrally over the bands.
An upright bottle has a narrow neck, sloping shoulders, and a rounded rectangular body. A long wick curves out of the mouth toward the right and ends in a forked, flame-like tip.
An oval hand grenade narrows into a rectangular top cap, with a long lever curving down its left side. Two horizontal divisions and a vertical lower seam segment the body.

A long missile points diagonally upward to the right, with straight sides, a pointed nose separated by a seam, and angular tail fins. A narrow central tail projection overlaps the leaf-shaped exhaust behind it.
A missile points upward to the right with a gently bulging body, a pointed nose divided by a diagonal seam, and two curved side fins. A detached tapered exhaust shape trails behind its flat tail.
A round bomb has a short tilted neck at its upper edge. A loose fuse emerges from the neck, arches upward, and curls to the right above the otherwise unmarked circular body.
A cannon barrel tilts upward to the right above a large wheel with a small central hub. Its rear curves into a hook, and a straight carriage trail extends diagonally down to the left.

A rounded rectangular controller has a short antenna centered above its top edge and two circular controls across its face. The right control has an indicator stroke, and a tall central recess opens at the bottom.
A blank gravestone has a rounded arch at the top and straight vertical sides. It stands on a wider rectangular plinth, with a plain uninterrupted face above the base.
An arched gravestone stands on a wide rectangular plinth, with straight sides below its rounded crown. The uppercase inscription RIP sits across the center of the otherwise plain face.
A long mortar tube leans steeply up to the right from a flat ground plate. Two splayed support legs attach beneath its raised section, and a short projection extends from the upper side.
A single elongated explosive stick lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with chamfered ends. A short fuse projects from its upper end and terminates among several radiating spark marks.
A small central body connects by four diagonal arms to circular rotor rings arranged symmetrically around it. Each arm continues into its rotor ring, giving the drone a compact four-lobed silhouette.
A side-view aircraft faces left with a rounded nose, a swept wing, and an upright tail. A separate horizontal bomb with a rounded nose and crossed tail fins hangs directly below the fuselage.

A drone viewed from above has a narrow central fuselage, rounded nose, broad tapered wings, and a smaller tailplane. Short propeller marks cross the wings, with another small crossbar behind the tail.
A thick cannon barrel points slightly upward to the right, with a round knob at the rear. A large hubbed wheel overlaps the barrel above a low angular carriage extending left.
A horizontal automatic rifle points right, with a broad stock on the left and a short projecting muzzle. A raised upper housing, slanted pistol grip, and curved magazine distinguish the body.
A long rifle rises gently to the right from a broad shoulder stock into a slender barrel. Its underside includes a small trigger guard, and a short front sight projects near the muzzle.
A cannon points up to the right from a compact carriage supported by two small wheels. A circular mounting pivot overlaps the barrel, and a short curved fuse rises from its rounded rear.
A flintlock pistol angles upward to the right, joining a long barrel to a curved grip with a capped butt. A rounded lock detail sits above the breech, while a small trigger curves beneath.
Two curved cutlasses cross at their blades, with pointed tips spreading upward and rounded handles below. Each broad blade has a bowed outer edge, and small guards project above the grips.
An extended spyglass runs diagonally from a small eyepiece at lower left to a broad rounded objective end at upper right. Stepped barrel sections and projecting collars mark the nested tubes.

A small aircraft lies tilted downward to the right, its wings and tail forming an angular silhouette. A large flame rises directly from the fuselage, and two separate wavy smoke trails drift above the rear.
Two horizontal wire strands pass through a central knot of overlapping diagonal loops. The outer loops extend above and below the strands, giving the twist a compact, roughly symmetrical silhouette.
An upright clenched fist has four rounded curled fingers above the palm and a thumb folded across its right side. A short wrist extends below, while radiating strokes surround the knuckles.
A horizontal canister at lower left has a small outlet at its right end. Two long curling trails rise from the outlet area, spreading upward as broad smoke-like waves.
A front-facing person raises both bent arms to hold two blank square placards on short poles. The round head sits between the signs above a curved torso, with each hand enclosing a pole.
A striding figure grips a long diagonal flagpole with both arms extended left. A large triangular flag spreads overhead, while the figure's bent legs and leaning torso create a forward-moving stance.
Three front-facing people stand shoulder to shoulder behind a wide blank rectangular banner. Their round heads and curved shoulders rise above it, and three pairs of short legs extend below.
A long rifle angles steeply upward to the right, with an angular shoulder stock at the lower left. The narrow barrel continues from a stepped body, with a rounded trigger guard beneath.
A rounded rocket points diagonally upward to the right, with a circular porthole high on its body and two angular side fins. A rounded nozzle joins a large leaf-shaped exhaust at the rear.
A helmeted soldier aims a long rifle horizontally to the left from behind three stacked sandbags. The head sits above a curved shoulder and torso outline, with a bent arm supporting the weapon.
A low rounded bunker rises behind a row of stacked sandbags, with a narrow horizontal firing slit across its face. A short pole carrying a notched flag stands on the roof.
A shotgun angles upward to the right from a short bent grip. Its long upper barrel runs above a rounded fore-end, and a small rectangular trigger guard projects beneath the rear.
A person stands in a wide bent-knee stance, leaning forward while aiming a long rifle horizontally right at shoulder height. One arm supports the barrel and the other bends near the stock.
A circular dial has short ticks extending outward at the four cardinal directions. A small central ring connects to a diagonal sweep line reaching toward the upper-left edge of the dial.
Three concentric circles share a center crossed by long horizontal and vertical sight lines. The straight lines extend just beyond the outer ring, forming a balanced four-way crosshair.
Two concentric circles surround a single diagonal sweep line that begins near the center and points toward the upper right. The line crosses the inner ring while stopping inside the outer boundary.
Two straight swords cross diagonally, with angular pointed blades spreading upward and rounded-ended grips below. Each sword has a straight crossguard, and the matching silhouettes form a balanced X.
A long narrow cannon barrel tilts slightly upward to the right over a single large plain wheel. An angular carriage trail extends down and left, meeting a short horizontal ground line.
Three simplified people form a compact group, with a larger central figure overlapping two smaller companions. Circular heads sit above rounded torsos that narrow into short integrated lower bodies.
A narrow gun barrel rises diagonally right from a compact breech above one circular wheel. A square muzzle cap ends the barrel, and angular stabilizing legs spread outward along the ground.
A large outer circle surrounds a smaller open central ring. Four short sight ticks extend outward from the inner ring at the top, bottom, left, and right without touching the outer circle.
A side-view underwater vehicle sits beneath a wavy waterline, with a rounded nose facing right and fins at the left rear. A jointed arm beneath the hull ends in an open pincer claw.
A broad symmetrical underwater drone sits below a wavy waterline, with two upright thrusters above its curved body. A central lower housing extends into two bent landing legs or gripping arms.
A side-view pickup faces right on two large wheels, with an angular cab and flat cargo bed. A large gun mounted behind the cab has a rectangular housing and a long horizontal barrel above the roof.

A squat fortress has a sloping left wall, flat upper roof, and upright right wall containing an arched doorway. A horizontal opening crosses the sloping face, a notched flag rises above, and waves meet the base.
